requirements.description: Compustat annual fundamentals — total assets, income before extraordinary items, common equity, shares outstanding, fiscal year-end, SIC code, sales, dividends
Compustat annual tax variables — current federal/foreign taxes, total income taxes, deferred taxes (for TAX and DEF fundamentals, plus accruals computation)
Compustat current liabilities (#5) — not directly available; substitute lct (total current liabilities, equivalent field under newer Compustat schema)
Compustat R&D (#46), capital expenditures, EPS (#58), dividends paid (#317) for the nine PRED controls and Table 6 robustness checks
Compustat cash flow from operations — direct measure (oancf, #308) used in robustness check of CFO; primary measure is IB - accruals from balance-sheet changes
CRSP monthly stock file — permno, date, ret, prc, shrout for monthly returns and May–April holding-period returns
CRSP monthly header — hshrcd (share code 10/11), hexcd (exchange), hsiccd (SIC) for universe filter and industry-year grouping
CRSP monthly delisting returns — dlret for the holding-period return reinvestment rule (delisted proceeds reinvested in NYSE/AMEX/NASDAQ VW index)
CRSP-Compustat CCM link table — lpermno → gvkey with linkdt / linkenddt PIT window for the gvkey ↔ permno join
I/B/E/S mean analyst long-term earnings growth forecast (GROW) in April of subsequent year — sample limited to 1982-2000

blocking_issues.reason: Compustat column 'cl' (#5, current liabilities) is not present in comp_202601.funda; the modern schema uses 'lct' (current liabilities total). The ΔCL term in the accruals formula (footnote 16) requires current liabilities.
blocking_issues.recommendation: Use 'lct' as a substitute for 'cl' — these are equivalent fields under the post-2003 Compustat schema (cl was renamed to lct, same data). Document the substitution in preparations/assumptions.md. (Substitution is exact, not approximate; no coverage loss.)
